Act14-2#1.zh: %N一行人在延安府待了三天，也就告别了王进，往梁山泊而行。不下数日，已来到梁山下...
Act14-2#1.t: %N and the others stayed three days in Yan'an, then bade Wang Jin farewell and set off for Liangshan Marsh. Within a few days they had reached the foot of Liangshan...

Act14-2#2.zh: 但见八百里梁山泊，港汊纵横，芦苇连天，宛子城雄踞在山顶上。
Act14-2#2.t: Before them lay the eight hundred li of Liangshan Marsh, its channels criss-crossing, its reeds stretching to the sky, and Wanzi Fortress towering on the summit.

Act14-2#3.zh: 报告大王！东溪村晁盖求见！
Act14-2#3.t: Report, Great King! Chao Gai of East Creek Village asks to see you!

Act14-2#4.t: 'Pagoda King' Chao Gai?! What's he here for?

Act14-2#5.zh: 在下王伦，久闻晁天王大名，如雷贯耳；今日光临草寨，真是令此处蓬壁生辉。
Act14-2#5.t: I am Wang Lun. Your great name has long thundered in my ears, Heavenly King Chao. Your visit today brings glory to our humble stronghold.

Act14-2#6.zh: 不敢。晁盖是个粗鲁之人，前日劫了官银，不得不落草为寇；久闻梁山泊地势险要，王兄在此做得一番事业。晁盖情愿于头领帐下做一小卒，希望王兄收容。
Act14-2#6.t: You flatter me. I, Chao Gai, am a rough man. The other day I robbed official silver and had no choice but to become an outlaw. I've long heard that Liangshan Marsh is a stronghold of great natural defences where you've built something fine, Brother Wang. I'd gladly serve as a common soldier under you, and hope you'll take us in.

Act14-2#7.zh: (我只是个不及第的秀才，只因和杜迁意气相投才到梁山落草；后来宋万加入，聚集了这么多人马。我没有什么本事，杜迁、宋万又武艺平常；这群人皆是虎背熊腰，晁盖又是远近知名的英雄好汉。要是被他们知道我没有什么功夫，想要强占梁山，我不就惨了吗...不如找个理由把他们打发下山...)
Act14-2#7.t: (I'm just a failed scholar who came to Liangshan because Du Qian and I got on; then Song Wan joined, and we gathered all these men. I've no real skill, and Du Qian and Song Wan are ordinary fighters. These men are all built like tigers and bears, and Chao Gai is a famous hero. If they learn I can't fight and decide to seize Liangshan, I'm done for... Better find an excuse to send them down the mountain...)

Act14-2#8.zh: 吾等皆愿跟随晁保正，投入王头领麾下！
Act14-2#8.t: We all wish to follow Headman Chao and serve under Chief Wang!

Act14-2#9.zh: 有话好说。来人！摆宴席为晁天王接风！
Act14-2#9.t: We can talk this over. Men! Lay out a feast to welcome Heavenly King Chao!

Act14-2#10.zh: 小喽罗们立刻上来安排宴席，杀鸡宰牛，不在话下。
Act14-2#10.t: The bandits at once came up to arrange the feast, killing chickens and slaughtering oxen, and so on.

Act14-2#11.zh: 王伦虚情假意，晁盖上当受骗！
Act14-2#11.t: Wang Lun feigns warmth, and Chao Gai is taken in!
